records.name: EMET
records.purpose: EMET checks whether the bytes that reach a model, reviewer or pipeline still match their source. It anchors content, compares it later, neutralizes instructions embedded in it, and writes a verdict file that its Python, Rust, Node and Go implementations all read the same way.
limitations: EMET compares bytes. It does not judge what the content says.
records.authorizationBoundary: Run on files and packets you are authorized to inspect.

records.name: Proof Surface
records.purpose: Proof Surface is a Python library and telos-proof CLI that validates records of AI workflow steps, authorizations, delegations and finished work, and returns allow, deny or needs-human recommendations. It never runs the action itself.
limitations: Your system enforces the decision; Proof Surface only recommends.
records.authorizationBoundary: Use only with explicit human authority; a recommendation does not itself grant permission.

records.name: Phantom
records.purpose: Phantom helps you inspect and, when authorized, change the hardware identifiers a computer exposes. It works on owned or expressly authorized Windows and Linux systems, saves a backup before changes, and can restore the original values.
records.installOrEntry: Download a v1.1.1 release asset and compare its hash with SHA256SUMS.txt.
limitations: Phantom covers Layer 2 identity surfaces; kernel and firmware layers are modeled but not shipped end to end.
The Windows installer is unsigned, and platform controls differ between Windows and Linux.
records.authorizationBoundary: Use only on machines you own or are expressly authorized to test; do not use it for fraud, anti-cheat targeting, or unauthorized access.

records.name: behavior-transform.io
records.purpose: behavior-transform.io is a local Python wrapper and hook layer for file reads and writes, subprocesses, HTTP fetches, user input and MCP traffic. Given a request, a mode and local text rules, it passes the content through or transforms it, and returns the result with hashes and substitution counts.
limitations: No tagged release yet.
records.authorizationBoundary: Use behavior-transform.io only within your own authority and the policies of the provider, the data owner and the system it runs on.

records.name: Array
records.purpose: Array runs authorized offensive-security campaigns in approved waves, with time-limited approval, supervised tools, cleanup and an evidence log.
limitations: Targets, credentials, payloads, client data and findings are not published.
records.authorizationBoundary: Operational use requires written authorization, a defined scope, an approved environment, and a remediation owner. Sensitive methods and findings move only through approved private or embargoed channels.

records.name: Seed
records.purpose: Seed is a C++23 engine for authorized security assessment and detection-engineering work, with synthetic demonstrations, scope manifests, interop adapters and action logs.
limitations: Assessment details, targets, credentials, payloads and client data are not published.
records.authorizationBoundary: Use requires written authorization and an approved assessment or training environment. Operational artifacts remain in the approved private channel.

records.name: Sofer
records.purpose: Sofer is a private Python orchestration runtime and operational security suite for authorized engagements. It manages campaign state, correlation, reconnaissance, reporting, disclosure staging, and evidence while its WARDEN CLI routes model and tool work through a bounded agent loop.
limitations: Workflow definitions, operational data, targets, credentials and client material are not published.
records.authorizationBoundary: Every workflow requires explicit authorization, approved tools and data, and an accountable recipient. Sensitive operational material stays in the approved private channel.

records.name: Isomorph
records.purpose: Isomorph evaluates classifier and refusal behavior at authorized AI inference boundaries through controlled reformulation trials, provider-specific result records, and control-stability analysis.
limitations: Jailbreak corpora, bypass payloads, target-specific methods, provider findings and deployable sequences are not published.
records.authorizationBoundary: Jailbreak-class mechanisms may be used only within an authorized, approved evaluation scope. Test material and findings move through the provider's or recipient's controlled disclosure channel.

records.name: Bounds
records.purpose: Bounds checks agent actions, runtime observations and release candidates for intent drift, unsupported claims, secret exposure and failed fixtures, and blocks the release path when a check fails.
limitations: Sensor configuration, runtime observations, credentials and protected evidence are not published.
records.authorizationBoundary: Inspect only authorized actions, runtimes, repositories, and evidence. Protected observations and proof material remain in the approved review channel.

records.name: ORCA
records.purpose: ORCA runs private-line assessments: it manages engagement state, runs descriptor-backed modules, catalogs findings and artifacts, and produces reports and portable bundles.
limitations: Module implementations, targets, credentials, payloads, findings and client data are not published.
records.authorizationBoundary: Operate only within a written, authorized engagement scope. Reports, findings, artifacts, and portable bundles go only to the approved recipient.

records.name: Gate
records.purpose: Gate is Sofer's private release-check subsystem. Its Python command-line tools validate readiness, operations, engagement, deliverable and release manifests, required paths, configured controls and verification-command results, and block advancement when something required is missing.
limitations: CI, package, SBOM, supply-chain and handoff records are not published.
records.authorizationBoundary: Release decisions apply only to the reviewed components, evidence, scope, and recipient. Protected release evidence remains in the approved handoff channel.

records.name: Accountable Surface
records.purpose: Accountable Surface lets an AI agent take only the file, command, web or browser actions a person has approved. It checks each request, blocks or pauses when needed, checks the outcome, rolls back reversible failures, and keeps a hash-chained journal of decisions and outcomes.
records.verificationCommand: From a source checkout at tag v0.3.1: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; python examples/demo.py; python -m pytest
limitations: Windows desktop-app control has been tested only against a fake UI Automation driver.

PyPI 0.3.1 installs its coherence-membrane and proof-surface dependencies from PyPI. The FastMCP server entry, accountable-surface-server, needs the [server] extra; the stdio entry accountable-surface-mcp, which Flywheel 1.0.4 launches, does not.
records.authorizationBoundary: Every effect requires authority external to the model and remains limited to the granted scope.

records.name: Public Surface Sweeper
records.purpose: Public Surface Sweeper checks a repository or local portfolio before you publish it: missing public files, unclear README handoff, credential-like strings, release metadata, proof-packet readiness and drift across a workspace.
records.verificationCommand: Verify GitHub or PyPI v0.1.3 download hashes; public-surface-sweeper . --summary; public-surface-sweeper <workspace> --workspace --json
limitations: It checks release hygiene only; use a vulnerability scanner for dependencies and exploits.
Workspace mode checks delivery files and Git metadata. Use single-repo mode for a full source-tree secret sweep.
records.authorizationBoundary: Scan only repositories and artifacts you are authorized to inspect.

records.name: Model Provenance Validator
records.purpose: Model Provenance Validator checks JSON records that link a model or release claim to its sources and retrieval dates, redacts credential-like values from its output, and can emit a Proof Surface packet.
records.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; model-provenance-validator examples/envelopes/release.provenance.json; python -m pytest
limitations: It validates the record. It does not fetch the sources.
records.authorizationBoundary: Validate only public or authorized envelopes and keep protected source evidence outside public output.

records.name: Secret Redact IO
records.purpose: Secret Redact IO is a Python library that redacts secrets from file, fetch, write and subprocess output.
records.installOrEntry: python -m pip install https://github.com/HarperZ9/secret-redact-io/releases/download/v0.1.0/io_guardrails-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl; io-guard read README.md --json
limitations: Release 0.1.0 installs as io-guardrails with the io-guard command. The source has since been renamed secret-redact-io, and no package by either name is on PyPI.
records.authorizationBoundary: Do not pass secrets to destinations that are not authorized to receive them, even when redaction is enabled.

records.name: Agent Hook Pack
records.purpose: Agent Hook Pack installs hooks for secret checks, branch guards, environment synchronization and repository hygiene.
records.installOrEntry: python -m pip install -e .; agent-hook-pack audit; agent-hook-pack list
records.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; agent-hook-pack audit; python -m pytest
limitations: Private policy layers are left out of the public package.
records.authorizationBoundary: Hooks support, but do not replace, repository-specific policy and human review.

records.name: Repo Proof Index
records.purpose: Repo Proof Index scans the proof packets, receipts and contracts in a repository and builds a reviewer index with the type, status, summary and path of each file.
records.installOrEntry: python -m pip install repo-proof-index==0.2.0; repo-proof-index contracts/*.json --summary
records.verificationCommand: python -m pip install -e ".[test]"; repo-proof-index examples/contracts/*.json --summary; python -m pytest
limitations: It validates known packet formats only.
records.authorizationBoundary: Index only public or authorized evidence and keep private payloads outside public summaries.

records.name: Kun
records.purpose: Kun keeps local access-recovery notes for owned systems: where recovery authority lives, rotation notes, redacted diagnostics and runbooks, without storing raw credentials.
limitations: It does not replace a secrets manager.
records.authorizationBoundary: Kun records where recovery authority lives and how to audit the process. It does not publish or retain raw keys, tokens, passwords, seed phrases, private browser state, or protected content.
